subject: Partner claim unblock — Orion integration accounts
messages:
From: Karen D'Souza <karen@orion-isv.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-21 09:12 PST
Subject: Orion x Redwood — urgent: account overlap blocking integration pilots

Hi Stephanie / Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we got good momentum with three mid-market customers who want the Orion + Redwood integration baked into their procurement. As we try to convert the pilot conversations into contracts, your GTM and field teams flagged that several of these customers are currently in Redwood-owned territories (CS + AMs assigned) and Orion sales says they have active POCs. The overlap is creating confusion on who owns the next steps (pricing, SOW, kickoff).

Attached is a quick account map (orion_account_map_v2.xlsx) showing the three pilot customers and their current Redwood contacts. We need a lightweight path to unblock these deals without creating long escalations on both sides. Can you propose a short playbook for claims and handoffs (what Orion needs to provide, how Redwood will validate, timelines)? Ideally we can land on a one-call handshake and a short routing rule for similar cases going forward.

Proposed attendees for a 30-min unblock call: Stephanie (Redwood GTM), Marissa (co-sell ops), Jonas (alliances), Karen (Orion Alliances), Liam (Orion AE).

We’re timeboxed — customers want training next week. Appreciate a quick ack and recommended next step.

Best,
Karen D'Souza
Head of Alliances | Orion ISV
karend@orion-isv.com

---
Attachments: orion_account_map_v2.xlsx (xlsx spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karen D'Souza <karen@orion-isv.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-21 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Orion x Redwood — urgent: account overlap blocking integration pilots

Karen — thanks for the clear map and timeline. Acknowledged and want to move fast.

Quick thoughts:
- We should avoid a heavy arbitration; propose a "3-account canary" approach: for these three pilots we do joint ownership for the pilot conversion (Orion handles initial SOW and technical onboarding; Redwood retains primary commercial ownership post-pilot unless ARR > $150k or strategic platform sale).
- We’ll use a one-page Partner Claim Unblock checklist (I’ll share v1) that requires: signed NDA/POC SOW (if applicable), point-of-contact confirmations, and a HubSpot note with the agreed routing.
- Call: available today 2:30pm PT or tomorrow 9:00am PT.

I’ll attach the playbook stub and a Draft routing rule we can adopt. If that sounds good we can lock the call and I'll loop in AMs as read-only.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

---
Attachments: partner_claim_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karen D'Souza <karen@orion-isv.com>
Date: 2028-11-21 11:15 PST
Subject: Re: Orion x Redwood — urgent: account overlap blocking integration pilots

+1 to the canary. A few operational guardrails I recommend we add to Steph's checklist: 

1) If the deal is > $150k ARR or includes platform-level entitlements, do not change commercial ownership automatically — escalate to Revenue Ops for a formal handback decision.
2) For deals where hardware/region SLAs are required (APAC-specific infra), Redwood should remain commercial owner unless Orion is the lead for multi-region support.
3) Add an evidence bucket: Orion must supply POC notes and customer confirmation (email or signed doc) that they are leading the feature ask.

I can populate the routing rule language for HubSpot (deal property + timestamped note) and run a short automation to set sub-stage to "partner-led pilot" for those deals so AMs don't re-engage duplicate outreach.

— Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karen D'Souza <karen@orion-isv.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@orion-isv.com>
Date: 2028-11-21 13:02 PST
Subject: Re: Orion x Redwood — urgent: account overlap blocking integration pilots

Thanks all — I like this pragmatic path. Operational notes from ops perspective: 

- If we run the canary, ops will set a HubSpot lock property for the three pilots for 21 days to prevent AMs from reassigning or aggressive outreach. That lock will expire automatically unless ops flags for escalation.
- I'll add the routing automation Jonas suggested and create one template HubSpot note we can use to capture customer confirmation and POC acceptance.
- Proposed handshake script for the 30-min call: 10' context, 10' confirm attachments/evidence, 10' agree on routing + timeline.

Call availability: tomorrow 9:00am PT works for me — suggest we send an invite now.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Co-Sell Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@orion-isv.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karen D'Souza <karen@orion-isv.com>
Date: 2028-11-22 16:05 PST
Subject: Re: Orion x Redwood — urgent: account overlap blocking integration pilots

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turn. Orion agrees to the 3-account canary and will send the POC SOWs + customer confirmation emails by EOD today. We also accept the ARR > $150k guardrail and will surface any platform-sales motions up front.

Karen and I are available for the 9:00am PT call tomorrow — please send the calendar invite and we’ll forward the POC notes.

Best,
Liam Chen
Enterprise AE | Orion ISV
